title: 🔆🔅Tehran - September 17 - Mohammad Reza Aref, First Vice President of Iran, made remarks during a speech at the University of Tehran.
text:
🔆🔅Tehran - September 17 - Mohammad Reza Aref, First Vice President of Iran, made remarks during a speech at the University of Tehran."

""
"SOT1, Mohammad Reza Aref, Iran's First Vice President, (Farsi)-(00:00 - 00:18): "We hope that the enemy comes to its senses and, for once, remains faithful to its covenant, and that this signed memorandum of understanding is implemented. Now, if it is implemented, is it over? No! Our issue with the hegemonic regime has only just begun.""

""
"SOT2, Mohammad Reza Aref, Iran's First Vice President, (Farsi)-(00:19 - 00:56): "They want to remotely destroy a large and significant number of people, or destroy equipment, or destroy civilizational works. They take pride in the fact that they are returning a civilized country to the Stone Age; these are presented as part of the achievements of today's information age in the world, and no one protests—even though this claim is not even accepted by the standards and criteria of the jungle.
